products.name: ÓLNATURE'S Nourishing Baby Oil
products.subtitle: ÓLNATURE'S Nourishing Baby Oil is specially formulated to moisturize, soothe, and protect your baby’s delicate skin from dryness. Fortified with Vitamin E, Olive Oil, and Almond Oil, this gentle, lightweight formula absorbs easily to keep skin soft, smooth, and deeply hydrated. Suitable for both face and body massage, it helps strengthen the skin barrier while providing gentle, soothing care for daily use.
